headline: CLE @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 3.41 at TEX 4.26, with a projected total of 7.68. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: CLE moved -0.25 runs while TEX moved +0.92, changing the projected margin by -1.17 runs. The projected total climbed +0.67, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -19.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jack Leiter has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, José Ramírez, Travis Bazzana, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Stuart Fairchild, Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
